summary: Khao kha moo is rice topped with soy-and-spice-braised pork leg, often served with pickles, greens and a chilli-vinegar or spicy dipping sauce. For a specific Bang Rak / Charoen Krung stop, Charoen Saeng Silom is a MICHELIN-listed street-food shop at 492/6 Soi Charoen Krung 49; it is a morning-only meal, not an evening street-food plan. December 2026 holiday operations and exact prices need reconfirming.
whyGo: Try a richly braised Thai-Chinese pork-leg rice dish at a long-running Bang Rak specialist.
A filling, practical breakfast or early lunch that can fit before other Silom or riverfront plans.
MICHELIN describes the pork as softly caramelised and served with house spicy sauce and pickles.
bestFor: Visitors who eat pork and enjoy tender, gelatinous cuts with sweet-savoury braising sauce.
A quick local-style breakfast near Charoen Krung.
Travellers comfortable with a simple street-food setting and cash payment.
skipIf: You avoid pork, need a vegetarian meal, or dislike fatty/gelatinous meat.
You want dinner: the listed shop hours end at 13:00.
You need confirmed step-free access, detailed allergen information or a posted menu price.
duration: Allow about 30–60 minutes for the meal and a short wait; this is a planning estimate, and queues or sold-out dishes may change it.
cost: MICHELIN classifies the shop in its lowest price band (฿), but no current menu price was verified. Carry Thai baht cash; add your own transport budget.
hours: MICHELIN currently lists Charoen Saeng Silom daily 07:00–13:00. Hours and holiday closures can change; verify close to your December visit and arrive early in case popular items sell out.
bestTime: Go in the morning, ideally before late morning, when the listed service is operating. December is generally comfortable for an outdoor walk compared with hotter months, but Bangkok remains warm; seek shade and water.
gettingThere: Use the address 492/6 Soi Charoen Krung 49, Silom Road, Suriyawong, Bang Rak. A taxi or ride-hail to the Soi is the simplest approach; road traffic can be slow. For rail, use BTS Saphan Taksin as a nearby area reference and check the final walking route on the day rather than assuming a short station-to-shop walk.
booking: No advance reservation is indicated. MICHELIN says the establishment manages its own bookings and lists a phone number (+66 2 234 4602); for a casual meal, confirm opening directly if making a special trip.
accessibility: The reviewed listing does not verify step-free access, seating layout or accessible toilets. Street-side premises and busy sidewalks may be difficult for wheelchair users; contact the shop before travelling if access needs are important.
practicalTips: Order khao kha moo (ข้าวขาหมู); ask for less fat or sauce if you prefer, though custom options were not confirmed.
Expect a rich braise; the chilli sauce and pickles add acidity and heat. Ask staff about ingredients if you have allergies.
MICHELIN lists the venue as cash only. Keep small baht notes and do not assume card or mobile payment is available.
Treat Charoen Saeng as a representative Bang Rak option, not the only place serving this widely available dish.
decemberNotes: No December 2026 schedule or holiday notice was found. The current listed daily morning hours are useful for planning but should be checked again near the trip, especially around public holidays and year-end.
uncertainties: Current menu prices, serving sizes and daily sell-out times are not published in the reviewed sources.
December 2026 holiday opening, temporary closures and any changes to listed hours are unconfirmed.
Accessibility details and exact step-free transport route were not verified.
